web.title: Video Anomaly Detection: Architecture, Twelve Labs, and NVIDIA VSS
web.description:
# [Anchor](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/tutorials-build-essentials/video-anomaly-edge-part-1/#video-anomaly-detection-architecture-twelve-labs-and-nvidia-vss) Video Anomaly Detection: Architecture, Twelve Labs, and NVIDIA VSS
## [Anchor](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/tutorials-build-essentials/video-anomaly-edge-part-1/#local-environment-setup) Local Environment Setup
```env
QDRANT_URL=http://localhost:6333
QDRANT_API_KEY=<your-qdrant-api-key>

# Twelve Labs (cloud video understanding)
TWELVE_LABS_API_KEY=<your-twelve-labs-api-key>
TWELVE_LABS_API_URL=https://api.twelvelabs.io/v1.3
TWELVE_LABS_MARENGO_INDEX_NAME=anomaly-marengo-search
TWELVE_LABS_PEGASUS_INDEX_NAME=anomaly-pegasus-summary
TWELVE_LABS_MARENGO_MODEL=marengo3.0
TWELVE_LABS_PEGASUS_MODEL=pegasus1.2

# NVIDIA VSS
NVIDIA_VSS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080
VSS_ENABLED=false

# Model
MODEL_NAME=MCG-NJU/videomae-base
MODEL_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:9877
ANOMALY_THRESHOLD=0.15
```

## [Anchor](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/tutorials-build-essentials/video-anomaly-edge-part-1/#why-knn-beats-classifiers-for-anomaly-detection) Why kNN Beats Classifiers for Anomaly Detection
| Model | AUC-ROC | Notes |
|-|-|-|
| Twelve Labs Marengo (cloud) | 0.9696 | Video-native, captures temporal dynamics |

This is why we use Twelve Labs Marengo in the cloud.

## [Anchor](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/tutorials-build-essentials/video-anomaly-edge-part-1/#building-the-twelve-labs-integration) Building the Twelve Labs Integration
**Marengo** handles embeddings and search, understanding _what happened_ in a video at the visual and audio level.

### [Anchor](https://qdrant.tech/documentation/tutorials-build-essentials/video-anomaly-edge-part-1/#semantic-search-with-marengo) Semantic Search with Marengo
This powers the investigative workflow: after an anomaly is detected via kNN, operators can search for similar events using natural language.
